mapper.select: SELECT p.post_number, p.post_title, p.create_at, p.user_number, p.board_number, p.view_count, b.region_name, b.board_category_name, b.post_category_name FROM tb_post p JOIN tb_board b ON p.board_number = b.board_number ORDER BY create_at DESC

SELECT p.post_number, p.post_title, p.post_content, p.create_at, p.user_number, p.board_number, p.view_count, b.region_name, b.board_category_name, b.post_category_name, u.user_name, COALESCE(r.cnt, 0) AS recommend_count FROM tb_post p JOIN tb_board b ON p.board_number = b.board_number JOIN tb_user u ON p.user_number = u.user_number LEFT JOIN ( SELECT post_number, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM tb_post_recommend GROUP BY post_number ) r ON r.post_number = p.post_number WHERE p.post_number = #{postNumber}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_post (post_title, post_content, board_number, user_number, create_at, view_count) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{boardNumber}, #{userNumber}, now(), 0)
